content.short: Coinbase Wallet SDK makes it easy for users to explore your dapp.
content.description: Coinbase Wallet SDK is an open-source toolkit that lets developers connect their applications to Coinbase Wallet users. Web apps can integrate Coinbase Wallet in three primary ways: (1) via the injected provider from the Coinbase Wallet browser extension; (2) by using the Coinbase Wallet SDK itself; or (3) by leveraging third-party libraries such as wagmi, Web3Modal, web3-react, and Web3-Onboard. This flexible setup provides multiple paths for adding wallet interactions to projects.
content.meta: Coinbase Wallet SDK connects apps to Coinbase Wallet users and is open source. Discover Coinbase Wallet SDK and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
